================================================================================
primitive types
================================================================================

variable "name" {
  type = string
}

variable "count" {
  type = number
}

variable "enabled" {
  type = bool
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (variable_block
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (variable_expr
            (identifier))))))
  (variable_block
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (variable_expr
            (identifier))))))
  (variable_block
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (variable_expr
            (identifier)))))))

================================================================================
collection types
================================================================================

variable "names" {
  type = list(string)
}

variable "tags" {
  type = map(string)
}

variable "unique_ids" {
  type = set(number)
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (variable_block
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (function_call
            name: (function_name
              (identifier))
            (function_arguments
              (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier)))))))))
  (variable_block
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (function_call
            name: (function_name
              (identifier))
            (function_arguments
              (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier)))))))))
  (variable_block
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (function_call
            name: (function_name
              (identifier))
            (function_arguments
              (expression
                (variable_expr
                  (identifier))))))))))

================================================================================
object type constraint
================================================================================

variable "config" {
  type = object({
    name    = string
    enabled = bool
  })
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(config_file
  (variable_block
    name: (string_lit)
    body: (block_body
      (attribute
        name: (identifier)
        value: (expression
          (function_call
            name: (function_name
              (identifier))
            (function_arguments
              (expression
                (collection_value
                  (object
                    (object_elem
                      key: (expression
                        (variable_expr
                          (identifier)))
                      value: (expression
                        (variable_expr
                          (identifier))))
                    (object_elem
                      key: (expression
                        (variable_expr
                          (identifier)))
                      value: (expression
                        (variable_expr
                          (identifier))))))))))))))
